steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You bunch... aren't from Ursus...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: *gasp* *gasp*...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Looks like they didn't have time to notify the others.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...Well done, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I really should review your capabilities more objectively.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Huh? Amiya... she's heading over to them...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Female
steps.text: Huh? Oh, thank you...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No problem. It's our...

steps.name: Female
steps.text: You... You're also an Infected?

steps.name: Female
steps.text: What do you want?! Don't hurt my children... I'm begging you, please don't hurt us...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Find a safe place to hide.

steps.name: Female
steps.text: *Crying* ... Please have mercy... Let us go...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Has everyone gotten enough rest?

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Ah, I'm fine...

options: Why is she afraid of you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You've also asked a similar question before.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Because I... am an Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dobermann and I, and most of the members of Rhodes Island, are as well.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even those Reunion members who we just fought...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've contracted a terrible illness. Something that terrifies most people...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: 'Oripathy.'

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Those who have contracted Oripathy are called the 'Infected.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dobermann...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Ursus has always treated the Infected harshly.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I mean, who doesn't? Ursus just happens to be particularly cold-blooded about it.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Civilians are taught to fear the Infected through propaganda. Nobody even bats an eyelid when the Infected are hunted down, and some even cheer for it.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: That's why Reunion chose this place...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: However... this time, it's not just a simple protest anymore.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: They've begun to resort to large-scale violence.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: When Ursus puts an end to the rioting, the Infected in Chernobog will only face more cruelty.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...In contrast, with you here, Dr. {@nickname}, perhaps Rhodes Island's situation will improve.

options: I see, I must be pretty important.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Both Kal'tsit and Amiya have mentioned that you are a cutting-edge Oripathy researcher.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...But with your memory loss, I doubt whether you'll be of any use again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ugh... Instructor, that's way too harsh!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...Perhaps you'll be able to master the theories again after some reviewing, just like how you relearned your commanding skills?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: After all, you are our field commander...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: To be honest, I never thought a neurology doctor could also be a master tactician...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But after seeing you, I can somehow understand it.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I mean, Rhodes Island itself is very similar to your field of study.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Hey! Damn you! Stop running! It's time for your injection!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Huh? Huh? I told you, I'm fine! I, I don't need treatment yet!

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: You need to get your regular injection to slow your symptoms!

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Didn't you say you were feeling dizzy?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: That's not the same condition at all!

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: What if you start having other issues when you're in battle?

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: For the sake of everyone's safety, you have to take care of yourself too!

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Stop right there! I'm giving you the shot!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Aaah! !

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...This is what Rhodes Island does. We're looking for a cure to the infection, as well as mitigating the problems associated with the Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's right. It is not enough to only conduct research, or only try to resolve conflicts.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We must address all of the problems surrounded the Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is the only way for Rhodes Island to give all the Infected a chance at survival...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We understand them better than most others because we, like them, are also Infected.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: No matter who is involved or what is required, Rhodes Island seeks to put an end to the spread of hatred and disease.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, perhaps this will be your calling as well.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...At least, this is my wish.

options: I need some more time to think about this.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We will give you plenty of time to let all of this sink in.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: However, the time given to us is scarce.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Gather up, everyone. We're leaving!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Anything could happen on our way to the meeting point!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (Amiya...)

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (The situation in Chernobog has become very complicated. We can't afford to create extra pressure for the rescue team. But...)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (How much time... do we have left?)

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (...Three hours.)

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (After three hours, this entire city will be consumed by the Catastrophe.)

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (After that, everything will be over then.)
We've found some unknown variables.
Notify the others, now.
We're going after them.
